utility.notes: Coronado is a well-documented San Diego County city within SDG&E's core service territory; the city's own solar page references SolarAPP+ as an alternative application path, consistent with SDG&E-territory records established elsewhere this session.

generation_supplier.notes: Coronado's City Council voted to begin the process of joining San Diego Community Power (SDCP), but as of this session Coronado is not yet a confirmed, currently-operating SDCP member city (SDCP's own confirmed member list is San Diego, Chula Vista, Encinitas, La Mesa, National City, and Imperial Beach). Left null rather than recording a pending relationship as active.

interconnection_url.notes: SDG&E's own utility-wide Net Energy Metering (NEM) interconnection page, already established for other SDG&E-territory records this session.

value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Center for Sustainable Energy (CSE), on behalf of SDG&E, under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized statewide budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025. Administered across SDG&E's entire distribution territory, which includes Coronado.
value.eligibility: PG&E, SCE, or SDG&E residential customers (general market tier)

battery_programs.notes: Reused as a utility-level fact from other SDG&E-territory records this session.
